They then jointly reported that the Le house was too chaotic to restore and that Annam need not be reconquered. The Emperor agreed.

Earlier, as Hue pursued them to the Red River, Sun Shiyi had wanted to recross and fight a decisive battle. Xu Shiheng had urgently dissuaded him, warning that losing senior officers would disgrace the empire, and had Company Commander Xue Zhong seize Sun Shiyi's reins and pull him back.
The source names the company commander 薛忠 (Xue Zhong).
In the sixth month he died in camp. He was posthumously made a duke with the temple name Wenjing.
In the sixth month he died in camp. He was posthumously made a duke with the posthumous name Wenjing.
諡文靖 is a posthumous name, not a temple name.
The rebels fell back to Qibao Stockade and Sun Shiyi marched after them.
The rebels fell back to Qigu Stockade and Sun Shiyi marched after them.
旗鼓寨 is Qigu Stockade; 鼓 reads gu.
Bandits retreated to hold Qibao Stockade; Shiyi moved the army to follow.
Bandits retreated to hold Qigu Stockade; Shiyi moved the army to follow.
旗鼓寨 is Qigu Stockade; 鼓 reads gu.
He first married a daughter of Prince Yunxiang while still a licentiate, became a prince consort, and was appointed Defender of Ceremonies.
He first married a daughter of Prince Lü, Yuntao while still a licentiate, became a prince consort, and was appointed Defender of Ceremonies.
履親王允祹 is Yuntao, Prince Lü; 祹 reads tao, and the princely title 履 is omitted.
In the spring of the forty-first year he was created First-class Baron of Courageous Assistance and given the double-eyed peacock plume.
In the spring of the forty-first year he was created First-class Earl Xiangyong (Courageous Assistance) and given the double-eyed peacock plume.
襄勇伯 is an earldom (伯), not a barony.
Initially as a scholar married Prince Yunxiang's daughter, became Doluo Efu, appointed Defender of Ceremonies.
Initially as a scholar married Prince Lü, Yuntao's daughter, became Doluo Efu, appointed Defender of Ceremonies.
履親王允祹 is Yuntao, Prince Lü; 祹 reads tao, and the princely title 履 is omitted.
In the forty-first year spring, ordered enfeoffed as First-class Baron of Courageous Assistance, bestowed double-eyed peacock feather.
In the forty-first year spring, ordered enfeoffed as First-class Earl Xiangyong (Courageous Assistance), bestowed double-eyed peacock feather.
襄勇伯 is an earldom (伯), not a barony.
He detached a force under Column Commander Kuilin, who crossed the river in leather boats and seized the two strongpoints of Sidi Mountain and Liangmu City.
He detached a force under Column Commander Kuilin, who crossed the river in leather boats and seized two wooden forts on the Sidi mountain ridge.
斯第山樑木城二 is 'two wooden forts (木城) on the Sidi ridge (山樑)'; there is no 'Liangmu City'.
Divided troops and gave them to Column Commander Kuilin; crossed the river in hide boats and took Sidi Mountain and Liangmu City, two places.
Divided troops and gave them to Column Commander Kuilin; crossed the river in hide boats and took two wooden forts on the Sidi mountain ridge.
斯第山樑木城二 is 'two wooden forts (木城) on the Sidi ridge (山樑)'; there is no 'Liangmu City'.

When the rebels came out he split a party to lie at Huangjin Temple, struck their works, and at the ambush's signal their cannon burst; the survivors shrank back into the city.
署湖廣總督 is acting governor-general; 賊砲裂 says the rebels' cannon burst, not a gunpowder magazine.

Bandits long held Xiaogan; Acting Huguang Governor Yongbao attacked them without success; Ming Liang led thirty-five hundred men thither; at Tongchuanpu bandits came out to fight; divided troops to ambush at Huangjin Temple, attacked bandit ramparts; ambush rose, bandit cannon burst, they drew into the city.

Bandits long held Xiaogan; Acting Huguang Governor-General Yongbao attacked them without success; Ming Liang led thirty-five hundred men thither; at Tongchuanpu bandits came out to fight; divided troops to ambush at Huangjin Temple, attacked bandit ramparts; ambush rose, bandit cannon burst, they drew into the city.
署湖廣總督 is acting governor-general, not governor.
At Shilong he fought hard, slew Shi Liudeng, and took his kin. He was made Second-class Baron of Courageous Assistance and given the double-eyed peacock plume.
At Shilong he fought hard, slew Shi Liudeng, and took his kin. He was made Second-class Earl Xiangyong (Courageous Assistance) and given the double-eyed peacock plume.
襄勇伯 is an earldom (伯), not a barony.
The White Lotus rising then spread through Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei. Ming Liang was ordered to take command in Sichuan and join Governor Yimian against the rebels.
The White Lotus rising then spread through Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei. Ming Liang was ordered to take command in Sichuan and join Governor-General Yimian against the rebels.
總督宜綿: 總督 is governor-general.
In the second year he entered Sichuan from Yongshun and united with Yimian.
In the second year he entered Sichuan from Yongsui and united with Yimian.
永綏 is Yongsui, not Yongshun (永順).
Besieged Shilong, fought fiercely, beheaded Shi Liudeng, captured his family, enfeoffed Second-class Baron of Courageous Assistance, bestowed double-eyed peacock feather.
Besieged Shilong, fought fiercely, beheaded Shi Liudeng, captured his family, enfeoffed Second-class Earl Xiangyong (Courageous Assistance), bestowed double-eyed peacock feather.
襄勇伯 is an earldom (伯), not a barony.
At this time the sect rebels rose, spreading to Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei provinces; ordered Ming Liang to supervise troops to Sichuan, join armies with Governor Yimian to suppress bandits.
At this time the sect rebels rose, spreading to Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei provinces; ordered Ming Liang to supervise troops to Sichuan, join armies with Governor-General Yimian to suppress bandits.
總督宜綿: 總督 is governor-general.
In the second year, Ming Liang from Yongshun entered Sichuan, joined armies with Yimian.
In the second year, Ming Liang from Yongsui entered Sichuan, joined armies with Yimian.
永綏 is Yongsui, not Yongshun (永順).

He chased them to Dushu, joined Governor-General Jing An of Huguang, and together drove the rebels into the Nanzhang hills.
Pursued bandits to Dushu, met Huguang Governor Jing An's army arrived, combined attack, forced bandits into Nanzhang mountains.
Pursued bandits to Dushu, met Huguang Governor-General Jing An's army arrived, combined attack, forced bandits into Nanzhang mountains.
Yao Zhifu of Xiangyang, Qi Wangshi, and their fellows slipped into Sichuan, linked with Sanhuai and Xu's Dazhou band, and the rebellion flared anew.
Yao Zhifu of Xiangyang, Qi Wangshi, and their fellows slipped into Sichuan, linked with Sanhuai and the Dazhou chief Xu Tiande, and the rebellion flared anew.
達州賊渠徐添德 names Xu Tiande; the translation reduces him to 'Xu'.
Lebao's brother Yongbao, already punished for failing at Xiaogan and Zhongxiang, resented Ming Liang;
Lebao's younger brother Yongbao, already punished for failing at Xiaogan and Zhongxiang, resented Ming Liang;
勒保弟 specifies a younger brother.
In the fifth year the throne recalled his earlier service and sent him to Hubei under Shaan-Gan Governor Songyun as a leader in the hunt. He was soon made Blue Plume Bodyguard and column commander.

In the fifth year the throne recalled his earlier service and sent him to Hubei under Shaan-Gan Governor-General Songyun with the banner rank of lingcui (corporal). He was soon made Blue Plume Bodyguard and column commander.
陝甘總督 is governor-general; 以領催 means with the banner rank of lingcui, not 'a leader in the hunt'.

In the fifth year, the emperor posthumously recorded former merit, with rank of leader hurried to Hubei to follow Shaan-Gan Governor Songyun to suppress bandits, soon appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard and Column Commander.

In the fifth year, the emperor retroactively recorded former merit, with rank of leader hurried to Hubei to follow Shaan-Gan Governor-General Songyun to suppress bandits, soon appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard and Column Commander.
陝甘總督 is governor-general; 追錄 means retroactively recorded (Ming Liang was alive), not 'posthumously'.
In 1811 he was demoted to Vice Censor-in-chief for concealing that his chair bearers had been gambling when the court learned of it.
In 1811 he was demoted to Deputy Lieutenant-General for concealing that his chair bearers had been gambling when the court learned of it.
副都統 is a banner deputy lieutenant-general, not a vice censor-in-chief.
When the rebels slipped back into Shaanxi he and Governor Ashibu struck together and turned them south again.
When the rebels slipped back into Shaanxi he and Governor Woshibu struck together and turned them south again.
倭什布 reads Woshibu; 倭 is wo.
In the sixteenth year, because sedan-chair bearers were gambling and the matter reached the throne, he did not report it truthfully and was demoted to Vice Censor-in-chief.
In the sixteenth year, because sedan-chair bearers were gambling and the matter reached the throne, he did not report it truthfully and was demoted to Deputy Lieutenant-General.
副都統 is a banner deputy lieutenant-general, not a vice censor-in-chief.
Bandits again entered Shaanxi territory; Ming Liang with Governor Ashibu combined attack, bandits returned south fleeing.
Bandits again entered Shaanxi territory; Ming Liang with Governor Woshibu combined attack, bandits returned south fleeing.
倭什布 reads Woshibu; 倭 is wo.
